MacBook Air (13-inch, M4, 2025)
A MacBook Air model introduced in 2025 with a 13.6-inch display, Apple M4 chip, unified memory, SSD storage, battery, camera, audio, wireless connectivity, and macOS.

Apple M4 Chip
Apple's M4 chip used in the MacBook Air, featuring a 10-core CPU, 8-core or 10-core GPU, hardware-accelerated ray tracing, a 16-core Neural Engine, and media engine capabilities.

Apple Intelligence
Apple's personal intelligence system that helps users write, express themselves, and get things done while emphasizing privacy protections.<SEP>A feature described as available in beta, with some feature and language availability limits.

Liquid Retina Display

Unified Memory
The MacBook Air memory configuration, listed as 16GB by default and configurable to 24GB or 32GB.

SSD Storage
The MacBook Air storage configuration, listed as 256GB SSD and configurable to 512GB, 1TB, or 2TB.

Lithium-Polymer Battery
A built-in 53.8-watt-hour lithium-polymer battery in the MacBook Air that supports up to 18 hours of video streaming and up to 15 hours of wireless web use.

MacOS
